bugs.title: Authorize.Net: Luhn-invalid card number accepted — ghost order created before tokenization
bugs.failedAssertion: Client-side Luhn validation should block submission of card 1234567890123456
bugs.stepsToReproduce: 1. Sign in as qa-agent-slot1@virtocommerce.com. 2. Add product to cart. 3. Select Fixed Rate (Ground) + Authorize.Net payment. 4. Enter card 1234567890123456, expiry 12/29, CVV 900, name John Smith. 5. Click Place order.
bugs.expected: Place order disabled OR inline error 'Invalid card number' — no order created.
bugs.actual: Place order enabled. Order 1957c7cc-60b7-4aa5-999e-b8fe11e090ea created, redirected to /checkout/payment. No client-side Luhn check.
bugs.notes: KNOWN/BY-DESIGN — Accept.js defers Luhn to tokenization. Documented as by-design per BUG-AN-cart-card-number-no-luhn-ghost-order.
